title: mizorewww/laya-mlx
why_read: A concrete, benchmarked example of running lightweight non-generative decision models locally on Apple Silicon extremely fast, which is technically interesting for on-device AI work.
analysis: This repository provides a native runtime built on Apple's MLX framework specifically for running 'Laya' typed decision models directly on Mac hardware. It reports very fast inference times of 7 to 14 milliseconds for short decisions on an M3 Max chip, explicitly avoiding heavier general-purpose tools like PyTorch, text generation pipelines, or cloud APIs. This is notable because it suggests a lightweight, specialized decision-model paradigm distinct from typical LLM-based approaches, optimized for low latency on consumer hardware.
